language_renditions.prelims: The source gives the whole prelims syllabus in Hindi and in English.
language_renditions.mains: The source gives Mains Papers I-IV in Hindi and in English; Papers V and VI are Hindi-medium and appear in Hindi only.

text.en: Page 8, 18, 45 of the source document are absent, so the English wording of Prelims Paper I subjects 1-2 (and most of subject 3), the Hindi wording of Mains Paper II Part A Unit 5, and the English wording of Mains Paper IV Part A Units 4-5 are not available in this file. Nothing was invented to fill them.

Examination administration — the notification, both exam plans, marks, durations, qualifying percentages and negative marking — is deliberately not part of this module. Where a Paper V or Paper VI table row mixed curriculum with a marks plan, the curriculum was kept and the marks annotation removed.

The source is an OCR transcription that retains its original typing, spelling and punctuation (for example "Knowlegde", "Diagonosis", "Populatin", "Scenerio"). Only transcription artefacts were normalised; the wording itself was left untouched, including typos.

The source heading for Prelims Paper II reads "…(प्रारंभिक) परीक्षा-2020", which appears to be a transcription slip for 2026; the syllabus beneath it is the revised Paper II issued with the 21.01.2026 notification.
Mains Paper V and Paper VI are Hindi-medium papers, so the source documents them in Hindi only. They are shown as they are; no English rendition exists to show.
